works.title: Ledger Therapy Algorithm
works.description: A therapeutic methodology that shifts the paradigm of mental illness treatment from introspective questioning to impact-based guilt elicitation. The approach uses a 'ledger' showing clients the concrete impact of their behavior on others as a response algorithm to bypass conventional therapy's conceptual blocks and drive reparative action.
works.quote: I am considering what I believe could become a paradigm shift and how we deal with treating mental illness. Conventional therapies all focus on the person asking them what they're thinking what they're feeling... The technique itself is basically a response to some of those safeguards
